TV host Bill Maher mocked #BTC and other cryptos, including #Dogecoin, on his show Friday. Maher stated he knows nothing about #crypto, yet proceeded to spew a bunch of crypto bear talking points. Does he have other motives, or is he just ignorant?

Why are so many people worried about supply ownership of $Doge? It does not affect its security characteristics since #Dogecoin is based on #PoW, and not #PoS, where supply concentration could be an existential problem.

$DOGE doesn't have the fundamentals but has a good foundation with its transaction payment method and good community. If Musk deploys more resources to improve the tech stack, (ie. privacy or smart contract capability), then #DOGE might be less of a meme and more of a reality...

Bloomberg’s Mike McGlone wonders if #Dogecoin has reached its peak and says he sees limited potential for this meme #crypto. Do not underestimate the power of the meme. Memes create communities, and community is a necessary ingredient in any successful decentralized network.
